before_episode.initial_object_poses: world pose of every object in the archived initial state (after settling), m and quaternion wxyz
before_episode.initial_joint_qpos: 27 driven joints at the initial state (rad)
before_episode.scene: table, robot base, lift, head, arm start pose, object offset/yaw
before_episode.dexonomy_target: Dexonomy grasp/squeeze/pregrasp qpos, required and hand contact bodies, contact points; object frame. Input for a goal-conditioned executor; label for a shape-to-target generator
before_episode.executed_target: world hand-root target, open and closure finger targets, approach axis/sign/standoff actually used

per_tick_observation_before_action_i.right_state: 27 driven joint positions (arm_r_joint1..7, finger_r_joint1..20), rad, float32, measured at timestamp[i] before action[i]
per_tick_observation_before_action_i.rgbm: head RGB at timestamp[i]; alpha = simulator target mask (privileged, stage 2 only)

per_tick_action_i.action: 27 actuator commands held over [t_i, t_i + control_dt] (10 physics substeps); fingers = position targets (rad); arm = joint position target + gravity bias qfrc_bias/kp at t_i (the bias itself is not stored)

teacher_internal_not_an_observation.phase: the teacher controller's stage label for tick i

per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.contact_groups: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.group_forces_min: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.group_forces_max: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.digit_force_max: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.target_height_min: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.object_xy_displacement_max: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.non_target_displacement_max: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.robot_object_penetration_max: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.robot_table_penetration_max: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]
per_tick_after_action_i_never_input_for_.robot_obstacle_penetration_max: aggregated over the 10 substeps after action[i]

not_stored.object pose per tick: only the initial pose (initial_state) and per-tick target_height_min / object_xy_displacement_max
not_stored.arm gravity-bias term per tick: so the pure arm joint target is not separable from action without replay
not_stored.hand root pose per tick: not stored; derivable by forward kinematics of right_state with the fixed base/lift (not done here)
